items.note: 3x3 between-subject experiment varies LLM temperature (0.1, 1.2) against a no-LLM control on RAT, AUT, and DAT and scores outcome creativity; random assignment is stated for the task factor, N not stated.
Between-participants visual ideation experiment (N=60) compares Midjourney support with a baseline and scores fixation, number, variety, and originality of ideas; assignment method not stated.

Extends Doshi and Hauser (2024): participants write stories with 1 or 5 plots from diverse GenAI personas or with none, and story diversity is measured; journal version of arXiv 2504.13868, N not stated in the abstract.
Compares divergent creativity of 9,198 humans with 215,542 LLM observations on an established creativity task; no participant receives AI help.

196 students solve a product improvement task alone, with free ChatGPT, or with 'think first, ChatGPT later', then all solve a second task without AI; creativity scored on both (with_ai and after_ai); assignment method not stated.

Field experiment with professional designers in logo contests compares AI-generated variations of exemplars with original exemplars and with no exemplars, scoring quality and originality; designers see AI output rather than use an AI tool, so the next stage should check fit and N.

Participants are 'experimentally assigned' to high-agency AI, low-agency AI, or human-only for alternative-uses ideation; creativity ratings and a preregistered similarity-to-centroid homogenization measure; N not stated.

36 architecture students design alone and then revise with an assigned workflow (GenAI image generation vs ArchDaily precedent search); judges rate design performance in a difference-in-differences; below 50 participants.

Between-subjects experiment (N=47) with No-AI, Co-led, and AI-led LLM whiteboard brainstorming; reports topical diversity of problems and solutions plus self-reports; below 50 participants, abstract from Semantic Scholar.

60 participants do motorcycle concept design in a 3x2x2x2 mixed design varying experience, tool proficiency, alignment strategy (Midjourney V6 vs ChatGPT-4o), and prompt type; quality, novelty, and diversity scored; no no-AI arm, AI-configuration comparison only; abstract from the Springer landing page.
